properties.areaDesc: Doniphan, KS; Andrew, MO; Buchanan, MO
properties.headline: Flood Warning issued September 30 at 10:26AM CDT until October 5 at 4:00AM CDT by NWS Kansas City/Pleasant Hill MO
properties.description:
...The National Weather Service in Kansas City/Pleasant Hill has
issued a Flood Warning for the following rivers in Kansas...
Missouri...

Missouri River at St Joseph affecting Andrew, Buchanan and Doniphan
Counties.

This product along with additional weather and stream information is
available at www.weather.gov/kc/.

* WHAT...Minor flooding is forecast.

* WHERE...Missouri River at St Joseph.

* WHEN...From Thursday evening to late Sunday night.

* IMPACTS...At 17.0 feet, Lowland flooding upstream and downstream
from St. Joseph occurs. At 19.0 feet, Backwater from the Missouri
River floods property along the Nodaway river at Nodaway, Missouri.
At 21.0 feet, Riverfront Park in St. Joseph begins to flood.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 10:00 AM CDT Wednesday the stage was 8.9 feet.
- Forecast...The river will rise above flood stage late tomorrow
evening to 20.7 feet Friday evening. It will then fall below
flood stage early Sunday morning to 6.7 feet Sunday, October 18.
It will rise to 6.9 feet Tuesday, October 20. It will then fall
again and remain below flood stage.
- Flood stage is 17.0 feet.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood

properties.headline: Flood Warning issued September 30 at 9:25AM MDT until September 30 at 1:15PM MDT by NWS Albuquerque NM
properties.description:
* WHAT...Flooding caused by excessive rainfall is expected.

* WHERE...Central Santa Fe County in north central New Mexico...

* WHEN...Until 115 PM MDT.

* IMPACTS...Flooding of rivers, creeks, streams, and other low-lying
and flood-prone locations is imminent or occurring. Streams
continue to rise due to excess runoff from earlier rainfall.
Low-water crossings are inundated with water and may not be
passable.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 924 AM MDT, Doppler radar and automated rain gauges indicated
moderate to heavy rain occurring over the area. Flooding is
ongoing or expected to begin shortly in the warned area. Up to
0.5 inches of rain have fallen on top of 1 inch of rain received
over the past 24 hours.
- Additional rainfall amounts up to 0.5 inches are possible in the
warned area. This will exacerbate arroyo and stream flooding that
was observed on the west and south side of Santa Fe yesterday.
- Some locations that will experience flooding include...
Santa Fe, Eldorado At Santa Fe, La Cienega, Cerrillos Hills State
Park, Los Cerrillos, Lamy, Galisteo, Canada De Los Alamos and
Agua Fria.
- Low water crossings along the Santa Fe River, Arroyo Hondo and
Galisteo Creek may become impassable due to runoff and impacts
from rainfall yesterday.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

Arroyos, streams, and normally dry rivers can become raging killer
currents in a matter of minutes. Water in arroyos can travel many
miles and take hours to reach your location from upstream rain areas.

properties.areaDesc: Monroe Upper Keys; Monroe Middle Keys; Monroe Lower Keys
properties.headline: Coastal Flood Advisory issued September 30 at 11:36AM EDT until October 1 at 5:00AM EDT by NWS Key West FL
properties.description:
* WHAT...Saltwater flooding.

* WHERE...Florida Keys.

* WHEN...Until 5 AM EDT Thursday.

* IMPACTS...Saltwater flooding of low elevation streets and lots
is expected. Some storm drains will overflow, and some
seawalls and docks will be overtopped. Boaters can expect less
clearance under fixed bridges. Motorists should remember that
persistent puddles around the times of high tide are almost
certain to contain a mix of saltwater.
properties.instruction:
If travel is required, allow extra time as some roads may be
closed. Do not drive around barricades or through water of
unknown depth. Take the necessary actions to protect flood-prone
property.
